title: table2struct
summary: Convert a table into row structs or a scalar struct of variables.

gpu_support.notes: Table and struct containers are host values.

description: `table2struct(T)` converts each table row into a struct with fields matching table variable names. `table2struct(T, "ToScalar", true)` returns one scalar struct whose fields contain whole table variables.
behaviors: The default conversion returns one row struct per table row.
`"ToScalar"` controls whether table variables are kept whole in one scalar struct.

examples.output: S = struct array with table variable fields

examples.description: Convert variables to one scalar struct
examples.output: S = scalar struct with table variable fields
